verse.text: But the love of the LORD remains forever with those who fear him. His salvation extends to the children's children of those who are faithful to his covenant, of those who obey his commandments!

video.title: Faithful Fatherhood - Episode 8: Passing Your Faith on to Your Children

reflection: God's covenant love doesn't stop with you — it's meant to flow through you into your kids and their kids someday. Every bedtime prayer, every honest apology, every 'let's talk about it' moment is a small deposit into that generational chain. You don't have to be perfect; you just have to stay faithful, one ordinary day at a time.
